entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Is he this Palace's...?

entries.speaker: Man in a Suit
entries.en: It's been quite a while, hasn't it?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Dr. Maruki!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Glad to see you're all doing well.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I pretty much figured that you would[n]end up infiltrating this place.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Truth be told, this isn't how I was[n]hoping we would meet again.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Dr. Maruki... You're the Ruler of this[n]Palace!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Palace?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: A place where distorted desires[n]manifest—we're asking if you're[n]the source of the desires here.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, I see.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, to use your own words: yes,[n]I am this Palace's Ruler.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But in my case, it seems a tad different[n]from the ones you've seen.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Would we also be correct in believing[n]that you're involved in the abnormalities[n]outside the Palace as well?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yes, you would.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Do you like the reality I created for you?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You... created it?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've gained the power to alter reality...[n]To make it whatever the people wish for.
Change it back.
I didn't wish for this.
That can't be...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Is that how you really feel?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...The old reality was cruel and unfair.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The truth is, Yoshizawa-san suffers[n]immense pain each and every time[n]she taps into her forgotten past.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, I definitely understand how this[n]could be hard to grasp.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: At any rate, our cruel and unforgiving[n]reality is going to change...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...and that includes Yoshizawa-san's[n]awful past, too.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: My... past?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Dr. Maruki... What do you mean!?[n]What's happened to me!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...All right.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I had honestly hoped that all those[n]warnings you were given would[n]change your minds...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But if it's your true desire, then I want[n]you to recall who you really are.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And I want you two to learn as well.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Once you have, you'll need to choose[n]between the two realities: the[n]merciless one, or the one I've formed.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: That's...
